methodology.downloads: All listed GitHub PST fixture paths were downloaded; PST magic and length checked. Eight Enron ZIP directories read remotely; three packages fully downloaded and PSTs parsed.
methodology.counts: IPM.Note objects in normal folder contents, without deduplication. Nested attachment messages are not recursively included. Other MAPI classes are reported separately. Enron imports can represent organizer entries as IPM.Note. Recovery of deleted/unallocated data and associated hidden messages was not performed.
methodology.errors: A parser failure is not proof that the file is corrupt. Null counts denote incomplete or unperformed traversal, not zero.
methodology.attachments: Attachment totals deliberately omitted: pypff raises attachment-access exceptions on some entries. Bodies and attachments were not comprehensively validated.
methodology.age: Observed dates are recorded verbatim and can be malformed. Approximate ages use 2026 minus the observed years. Filename Outlook version labels do not establish content age.
methodology.units: Bytes exact; MiB is 2^20 bytes; Enron download sizes are ZIP bytes and expanded_pst_bytes sums PST members.
